name: viralgenhub-extension
description: ViralGenHub browser extension: connects cookie-based channels (Skool)

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && vite build && node scripts/write-manifest.mjs && cd dist && zip -r ../extension.zip . -x '.*'
scripts.dev: rm -rf dist && HOT_RELOAD_EXTENSION_VITE_PORT=8081 NODE_ENV=development dotenv -e ../../.env -- vite build --config vite.config.chrome.ts --mode development --watch
scripts.build:staging: rm -rf dist && EXT_ENV=staging vite build && EXT_ENV=staging node scripts/write-manifest.mjs && cd dist && zip -r ../extension-staging.zip . -x '.*'
